svg.title: Aria 301_305: controlled refinement; representative frame 1180
svg.desc: Measured PSNR, equal mean over five fixed event cohorts. Each diagnostic iteration renders one view and makes one Gaussian Adam update. Current causal evaluation poses held fixed, no incoming observations. Own initial online maps. This is not a native end-to-end runtime benchmark.
svg.text: Controlled refinement: fixed input and poses
5 event cohorts; 1 rendered view per iteration
